name: miyu-companion
description: Miyu — an animated multi-platform companion (Windows / Linux / macOS native, Android native, iOS companion, portable HTML fallback) with local-first privacy and optional model connections.
author: Miyu Studio

scripts.package:win: node tools/build-portable.mjs && cd desktop && go run ./resourcegen && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -H windowsgui" -o ../deliverables/Miyu.exe .
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run build:portable && cd desktop && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../Miyu-Linux-x86_64 .
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run build:portable && cd desktop && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../Miyu-macOS .
scripts.build:all: npm ci && npm run build && npm run build:portable
